name: plan-view
description: Shows Claude's plan-mode plan in a pane beside the chat and updates it live as Claude writes

autoOpen.title: Open automatically
autoOpen.description: Open the pane when Claude writes a plan. Off: only /plan-view opens it.

width.title: Pane width
width.description: Share of the terminal the side pane's content asks for, plus its frame: narrow about 30%, medium about 38%, wide about 45% (the most Claude Code allows).
